output.review_comment: Cannot approve without PR description and docstring context. The changes involve multiple logic modifications (ceiling division, rounding via magic number 5000, min/max reordering) with no explanation. The addition of 5000 for rounding is suspicious and could indicate test-fitting rather than specification-compliance. Please provide: (1) PR description explaining the changes, (2) full docstring showing specification, (3) the failing test cases, and (4) verification that changes match docstring requirements.
